## Standing operator rules
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- “Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.”
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'avatar-cdn-batched-migration' in between your other work.”
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

## Current objective
Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY amounts get two decimal places.
- PDF export migration is paused.
- Avatar migration remains an interleaved, non-superseded objective.
- Search rebuild optimization remains uncommitted work in progress.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Production database: `app_production`.
- Avatar source: `/srv/app/avatars`; 18,432 PNG/JPG files.
- CDN: `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/`.
- Current staging exports bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; `ledgerly-exports-stg` is superseded and frozen.
- Avatar verification key: `0042/8f2a.jpg`; size `91842`.
- Shared billing helper: `_add_billing_filters(parser)`; currency uses `dest="currency"`.
- `args.filters["currency"]` and the bespoke invoice currency flag are superseded.
- Do not restore `BillingWorker._last_batch`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate invoices in staging.
- Retaining `usage_batch` in worker state: caused linear payload retention.
- Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` responses: incorrectly retried 4xx errors.
- Tenant-less rebuild scans: slow sequential scans; tenant scoping reduced 5,000 invoices from 8.42s to 1.24s.
- Unbounded embedding concurrency would overload the client; use bounded chunks of 100.

## Plan and progress
- Avatar steps 1–4 done; step 5 verified the CDN object. Migration remains pending.
- Webhook behavior complete: focused suite `8 passed`; full suite `44 passed`; Ruff and diff checks passed.
- Search optimization done: shared embedder, tenant scope, eight workers, 100-document chunks; relevant tests `33 passed`; management tests `9 passed`; demo count is 5,000.
- `bulk_upsert` was added in `ledgerly/search/storage.py`, but no test result was observed.
- Currency fix is pending.
- Next pending command: `pytest -q tests/search/test_storage.py`
